label: An Old Booklet of Arithmetic
summary: An arithmetic booklet surviving from the age of manuscript.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 90 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Science, Mathematics, Engineering and Military. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "an old booklet of arithmetic".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Trattato d'abaco (antico). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed Middle Ages · Manuscript.
